IT Security Advisory - SEC-2026443

Date: 2026-12-07 | Severity: HIGH | Status: Open
Affected: API Gateway

Summary:
Weak encryption detected

Technical Details:
TLS 1.0 still enabled on legacy endpoint

Impact:
Potential data exposure

Required Actions:
1. Restrict security group (Owner: Security Team, Due: 2026-01-18)
2. Run vulnerability scan (Owner: Backend Team, Due: 2026-07-04)
3. Deploy WAF rules (Owner: Platform Team, Due: 2026-04-03)

Workaround:
